content: Anvi Desai emailed insurance agent Ravi Menon to confirm the cancellation of her health policy (HP-DC-2024-7890) following a previous phone conversation. Ravi Menon responded confirming that the cancellation has been processed, the policy will terminate on 30/09/2026, and a final statement with any applicable refunds will be sent within 7-10 business days along with an attached confirmation document.

action_items: Customer to review attached cancellation confirmation
Agent to process final statement and refund within 7-10 business days
